title: Mage Pipeline Freshness SLA
app: Mage pipeline run events via the Mage API to HEC and scheduler logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=mage:pipeline status="completed"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by pipeline_uuid
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>12
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Mage pipeline and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A pipeline can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Mage.
implementation: Ingest Mage success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical pipeline exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of pipeline by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Mage has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
